C0667.title: Man Sentenced for Extorting Over 20 Restaurants by Falsely Claiming Flies in Food
C0667.summary: A man surnamed Chen, born after 2000, extorted over 8,000 yuan from 29 merchants within four months by falsely claiming to have found flies in his delivered meals. The Beijing Changping Court recently heard the case and sentenced Chen to prison for extortion.
